description: Enterprise ATT&CK tactics used for adversary emulation classification

terms.label: Reconnaissance
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to gather information they can use to plan future operations.

terms.label: Resource Development
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to establish resources they can use to support operations.

terms.label: Initial Access
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to get into your network.

terms.label: Execution
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to run malicious code.

terms.label: Persistence
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to maintain their foothold.

terms.label: Privilege Escalation
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to gain higher-level permissions.

terms.label: Defense Evasion
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to avoid being detected.

terms.label: Credential Access
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to steal account names and passwords.

terms.label: Discovery
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to figure out your environment.

terms.label: Lateral Movement
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to move through your environment.

terms.label: Collection
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to gather data of interest to their goal.

terms.label: Command and Control
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to communicate with compromised systems to control them.

terms.label: Exfiltration
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to steal data.

terms.label: Impact
terms.definition: The adversary is trying to manipulate, interrupt, or destroy your systems and data.
